## Introduction

Hello again, today I will be showing you what I have been doing for my research through a presentation - and I will make it interactive through a mini quiz. This will be on this site.

You will be given (or have been given) a randomly selected sticker, either representing a *Ceratitis capitata* or a *Drosophila melanogaster.* This is your team, you will answer the multiple choise questions at the end of each quiz these will be added together depending on the team.

The winning team gets... something.

**Rules:**

-   Please don't click any of the quiz question tabs until it is time to do the quiz.

-    When you are in the multiple choice, please only try once, once you have submitted do not try again.

-   Do not leave or refresh the page, you will lose your score.

-   Your total score will be at the bottom of the page.
